result.summary: Found 1 issue: a delivery fee displays as an invalid numeric value (NaN) on a restaurant card.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery price, indicating a failed number calculation or missing fee value.
issues.suggestion: Guard the delivery-fee formatting so a missing or non-numeric value falls back to a valid amount or a placeholder like 'Delivery fee unavailable' instead of rendering NaN.
